svg.title: 03 extension native reflow v4 page05
svg.desc: Extension page 5: 13 outcomes and all 12 sleep traits, with marginal rg and SE; row height follows full label length. Dots: original all-1,200 BH q < 0.05. Fixed scales across pages. Exact values and marginal intervals are in the table. No calibrated contrast is shown. Act. = actigraphy; source qualifications remain.
